adaptations: Inputs and outputs use caller-supplied paths.
Ridge evaluation uses the paper's nested feature-group protocol and training-partition transforms.
Model-comparison uncertainty and pair-bootstrap reference uncertainty have separate runners.
Replay reads ordered JSON records; callers normalize project-specific aliases.
Public module names, result keys, and method documentation follow the paper.

supplementary_documents.METHOD_DETAILS.md: Feature construction, Ridge inputs and objective, evaluation, audit, replay, timing
supplementary_documents.prompts.md: Verbatim pointwise scoring rubrics and input template

source_hash_scope: Checksums of source implementations before standalone adaptation; keys identify their public modules or roles.

analyses.evaluation.py: Nested Ridge, matched baselines, ablations, and calibrated OOF scores.
analyses.uncertainty_controls.py: Paired uncertainty, seed baseline, neutral-prior and expert-pair scoring.
analyses.scenario_only_control.py: Gemini scenario scoring with rubrics from prompts.md and an environment-supplied credential.
